description:
Blank Audio Cassette Tape Lot  13 Tapes
Mixed Brands, 1980s-1990s
TDK, Maxell, Realistic, Certron
A diverse collection of thirteen blank audio cassette tapes featuring leading magnetic media brands from the late 20th century. This lot is notable for containing a high proportion of factory-sealed vintage stock, which remains highly sought after by analog recording enthusiasts for their specific sonic characteristics and period-correct aesthetics. The selection spans various formulations including standard Normal Bias and high-performance Chrome-equivalent tapes.
9 Factory-Sealed tapes and 4 unsealed/opened tapes
Mix of 60-minute and 90-minute recording lengths
Includes Type I (Normal Bias) and Type II (Chrome/High Bias) formulations
Features TDK D90, Maxell UR series, and Realistic Supertape HD-90
Condition:
Nine tapes are factory sealed in original cellophane; several wrappers exhibit light shelf wear, minor corner scuffs, or remnants of vintage retail price stickers. Four tapes are unsealed and housed in standard clear protective cases; the recording status and internal J-card condition of these opened tapes have not been verified. Clear plastic cases on unsealed units show typical surface scuffing and light scratches from storage. Realistic Supertape and one Maxell XLII-S represent the Type II High-Bias media in this collection.

All items are donated and may exhibit signs of wear, including surface dirt, discoloration, scratches, and scuffs. Glassware and dishes may display color fading, crazing, or chips. description:
Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

This vintage and modern writing and sealing set includes a boxed NVIZIO Sunlight Pen Collection with multiple black and gold pens, a Bradley gold-tone ballpoint pen in original case, and a Parker Classic stainless steel pen in presentation box. Late 20th Century, France
This Waterman Paris fountain pen exemplifies the elegant French design and reliable engineering that defined the brand's production after moving operations to France in the mid-20th century. Featuring a slim, sophisticated profile, the barrel and cap are finished in a dark lacquer with subtle vertical burgundy stripes, complemented by gold-tone accents and rings. The Waterman brand, established in 1884, is renowned for inventing the first functional fountain pen feed, a legacy of quality visible in this late vintage example.

description:
Sheaffer
Lady Sheaffer Fountain Pen - Gold-Tone Brushed Finish
Vintage (Circa 1958-1960s), 1 Pen with Case
This Lady Sheaffer fountain pen represents the intersection of mid-century fashion and high-quality craftsmanship from one of America's most prestigious pen manufacturers. Part of the "Skripsert" line launched in the late 1950s, these pens were designed specifically as stylish accessories for women, often featuring clip-less designs or refined jewelry-like finishes. This specific example features a sophisticated brushed gold-tone finish complemented by an intricate, ornate engraved band on the cap, showcasing the brand's commitment to both utility and style during the peak of fountain pen production.
"Lady Sheaffer" branding clearly visible on the interior lid of the original case
Distinctive brushed metal body with an ornate floral scroll engraved band on the cap
Includes original blue textured hard shell case with satin-lined interior
Accompanied by the internal metal cartridge sleeve/converter housing
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The brushed metal finish shows light age-appropriate surface wear and minor tarnish consistent with use. The ornate cap band remains well-defined. The nib is present and appears straight, though the pen is currently untested for ink flow. The original case shows light exterior wear and storage dust; the hinge functions correctly and the interior lining is intact.

description:
Wahl Signature
Gold Filled Ring Top Fountain Pen
Early 20th Century
This vintage Wahl Signature fountain pen features a gold-filled case with a classic chased geometric pattern. Produced during the golden age of American writing instruments, this "ring top" model was designed for portability, intended to be worn on a watch chain or chatelaine. The nib is clearly marked "Wahl Signature Pen 14K," identifying the high-quality gold content characteristic of these premium writing tools. The barrel is personalized with the engraved name "E. BURKLE."
Wahl Signature 14K gold nib (tested and marked)
Vintage gold filled case with decorative chased design
Ring top attachment for chain or lanyard use
Lever-filler mechanism for ink loading
Approximately 3.75 inches in length
Condition:
Vintage condition with visible signs of age and use. The gold-filled surface shows a natural aged patina and minor surface scratches; no significant dents or plating loss observed on the exterior. The personalized engraving "E. BURKLE" is deep and legible. The internal section shows significant ink residue and oxidation at the threads and section joint. The nib shows surface wear and staining but remains structurally intact. The filling mechanism has not been restored; functionality of the internal ink sac is unknown and should be assumed to require service for writing use.
Warehouse Location: Canton
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

Sea Captain Smoking a Pipe
Oil on Canvas
21" x 25.5" (Frame Size)

This classic maritime portrait features an elderly sea captain with a voluminous white beard smoking a pipe, rendered in a traditional realist style. Signed by the artist "Van Meer," this work is characteristic of mid-20th-century nautical genre paintings. The composition uses a dark, atmospheric background to emphasize the weathered features and contemplative expression of the subject, capturing the rugged character of a seasoned mariner.
Fine brushwork detailing in the textured beard and expressive facial features

Canvas is professionally stretched and secured with metal clips to the frame reverse
Frame dimensions: 21" Wide x 25.5" High x 1" Deep

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

Cross
Writing Instrument Set - 14KT Gold Filled

This vintage writing set from A.T. Cross Company represents the timeless elegance and precision engineering that has defined the brand since the mid-19th century. Featuring the slim silhouette characteristic of classic Cross designs, these instruments are finished in 14KT gold filled metal, offering a luxurious aesthetic combined with the durability required for daily use. Includes original brown branded hard case, fabric sleeve, and two medium ink refills (one in original gold tube)

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

Golden Healer Quartz Polished Specimen
Natural Crystal Flame Carving
Polished Stone, 7 Inches, 2.28 Pounds
A striking specimen of Golden Healer Quartz, characterized by its warm honey and amber hues resulting from natural iron oxide inclusions. This piece has been expertly carved into a flame-inspired freeform shape and polished to a high-gloss finish, highlighting the intricate internal veining, banding, and crystalline structures. These specimens are highly prized by mineral collectors and enthusiasts of natural stone decor for their vibrant coloration and organic aesthetic.
Hand-polished Golden Healer Quartz featuring characteristic yellow and golden-orange limonite staining
Carved flame silhouette with a flat-ground base for stable upright display
Displays natural internal fractures, phantoms, and inclusions typical of authentic quartz specimens
Dimensions: 7 inches x 4 inches x 2.5 inches; Weight: 2.28 lbs
Condition:
The stone surface is smooth with a brilliant luster. Natural surface-reaching fissures and deep internal inclusions are present, which are characteristic of natural quartz and are not considered defects. The base is stable and flat. No significant post-polishing chips or impact damage observed on the carved edges or points.
